title.en: An Act Authorizing An Additional Appropriation of One Hundred Thousand Pesos as Aid for the Establishment of New Elementary Classes.

text.en:
The sum of one hundred thousand pesos is hereby appropriated, out of any funds in the Insular
Treasury not otherwise appropriated, for the salaries of teachers of new elementary classes in the barrio or
central schools of the Philippine Islands.

The amount herein appropriated shall be distributed by the Director of Education with the
approval of the Secretary of Public Instruction: Provided, That, any provision of the existing law to the
contrary notwithstanding, no unexpended balance of the amount appropriated herein for salaries of teachers
shall be transferred to the credit of the Teachers' Pension and Disability Fund: And provided, further, That no
municipality or city shall receive aid from this fund unless the barrio or poblacion where the new class is to be
established meets the ordinary requirements of attendance and has on the date of the approval of this Act an
adequate school site and a suitable building for holding classes.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, August 3, 1935.
